fallback.hint: What the device runs at any hour no rule covers.
fallback.label: Fallback profile

fromProfilesNote: While the schedule is on, the device's settings come from the profiles below. To change what it runs, edit a profile.
intro: Switch this tracker between named profiles on a weekly timetable — reporting less often at night, say, or sleeping through the weekend. The server evaluates the schedule and pushes each change the same way saving settings by hand does, so nothing has to be reflashed and the tracker does not need to be online at the moment a window opens.
loadErrorHint: If this keeps saying the schedule was not found, the server this dashboard is talking to is older than the dashboard itself and does not have schedules yet — it needs updating.

message.disabled: Schedule turned off. The device keeps its current settings until you change them.
message.enabled: Schedule enabled — the profile in force has been applied.
message.enabledWithDefault: Schedule turned on. Your current settings were saved as the profile "{{name}}", which applies at all times until you add a rule.
message.rulePaused: Rule paused — it will not apply until you resume it.

modeSwitch.offHint: The device always runs on the settings in Reporting & Power below.
modeSwitch.onHint: Switch between named profiles by day and time — for example, report less often at night or over the weekend.
modeSwitch.willCreateDefault: Saving copies the current settings into a profile called "{{name}}", which applies whenever no rule does. Nothing changes on the device until you add a rule.

override.label: Overridden
override.resumeHint: Discard the manual settings and apply the scheduled profile now
override.resumesNextSwitch: The schedule resumes at the next switch.

profile.heading: Profiles
profile.inForceWarning: This profile is in force right now, so saving changes what the tracker is running immediately — not at the next switch.
profile.intro: A profile is a complete set of this device’s settings under a name the rules refer to.
profile.name: Profile name
profile.nameRequired: Give the profile a name — it is how the rules refer to it.

rule.errorNoDays: Pick at least one day. To park a rule without losing it, untick "Enabled".
rule.errorNoProfile: Choose the profile this window should apply.

ruleList.empty: No rules yet — the fallback profile applies at all times.
ruleList.heading: Rules
ruleList.intro: Listed in the order they are evaluated — lower priority number first. The first rule whose window contains the moment wins; if none does, the fallback applies.

status.awaitingFirstPass: Waiting for the scheduler’s first pass — this is what it will apply.
status.deviceAdrift: The tracker was not where the schedule put it; a correction has been sent.
status.deviceBehind: It has not picked up the latest schedule yet.
status.neverSwitches: This schedule never switches — the same profile applies all week.
